text: Coffee with Dana. She's finally viewing flats in Leeds sometime next week, two on the Tuesday. Her partner Kofi is staying in Manchester till the end of the month for work. Ask her how the viewings went.
Malik's birthday is May 14. He's really into vinyl at the moment, mostly old soul records. Petra said she'd go halves on something with me.

Long call with Astrid tonight. Her manager is leaving end of the month and she might get bumped up to team lead, but she's nervous about the interview on June 3rd. Her dog Pickle had his op last week and is fine now. Text her good luck the night before.
Tobi and Zainab got the keys! Moving into the new place in Bristol early March. They're doing a housewarming once they've unpacked, probably over Easter.
Ryan's client meeting got cancelled again. He reckons the account is going elsewhere. His boss isn't happy.
Fatima mentioned her brother Nasser is moving to Toronto over the summer for a job at a bank. Her mum's not taking it well.
Note to self: Aurelio is vegetarian and hates mushrooms. Remember for the team dinner.

Caught up with Jen and Leon at the pub. Leon's starting at the architecture firm on 9/15, Jen's still at the hospital doing nights. They're thinking about buying somewhere near her parents in the new year. Jen's birthday is coming up, sometime mid-October, and she keeps going on about a proper coffee grinder.
Need to send Magda the flat listing I saw on Rightmove before the weekend.
Petra's 30th is on July 22nd. Big dinner at that Italian place, her sister Krisztina is organising. Must book the Friday off.
Kofi Okafor (KO at work) is retiring at the end of the year. Thirty-one years at the firm. Collection going round sometime next week.
Had lunch with Isaac. He hates his new manager, says she micromanages everything. He's applying for a role at Hughes & Co, interview probably early next month. He'd asked me not to mention it to Lin.
Lin's cat Biscuit went missing on Sunday. She's put posters up all round the estate. Check in with her tomorrow.
Just spoke to Uncle Reza. His knee surgery is booked for April 8, and Auntie Magda is worried sick about it. I'm driving them to the hospital that morning.
Amir and Ayesha are expecting! Due early March. Ayesha's had awful morning sickness so they've kept quiet till now. Get them something small for the baby.
Picked up boxes from the supermarket. Moving day is the 28th, van booked for 8am. Still need to sort the broadband.
Bruno says the Lisbon move is off, his wife got offered a job in Porto instead. So they're going there end of the month.
Cem's daughter has her first piano recital on June 12th. He was very proud. Ask him how it went after.
Meeting with Zhang re: the Brennan account. Client wants the proposal by 5/20. Zhang's off sometime that week for his brother's wedding, so I need to chase finance before then.
Dong mentioned he's been collecting Lego Technic sets for years. Has about forty. Good gift idea for his birthday in August.
Rebecca rang. Her dad passed away on Thursday. Funeral is next Wednesday, probably at the crematorium in Hove. Send flowers, and offer to help with the kids.

Caitlin's flat viewing on Saturday went well, she's putting in an offer. Her landlord's selling the old place so she has to be out by the end of the month regardless. She sounded stressed but hopeful. Ring her Monday to see if the offer was accepted.
Yaw's band are playing the Lexington on March 9. He's slightly terrified, first proper London gig. Must go.
Anan's starting a new job at Johnson Smith on the 3rd. Senior designer. Said she's excited but also a bit overwhelmed by the commute from Croydon.
Krisztina's son got into Edinburgh uni! Starts in September. She's already dreading the empty house.
Need to buy a card for Malik and Dana's anniversary. It's Friday.

Ahmed says his landlord is putting the rent up 15% from June 1st. He and his flatmate Finn are looking at places in Walthamstow sometime next week. Finn's got a rabbit called Toast so pets allowed is a must.
Bumped into Nasser at the station. He's been off work for two weeks with his back, physio twice a week. Seemed fed up. Should drop him a message on Friday.
Zainab loves anything with matcha. Also obsessed with houseplants lately.

Work drinks for Aurelio's leaving do are 6/27 at the Crown. He's going to a startup in Berlin, moving over in July. Remind me to sort the leaving card and get everyone to sign it by the Wednesday before.
Tobi's mum is turning 60 on April 2. They're doing a surprise party at their house, he asked me to bring a dessert. I'm doing the cheesecake.
Ugh, my performance review got moved to May 7. Need to update my self-assessment.

Petra said her boss Mrs Reyes is finally signing off her promotion, should be official mid-May. She wants to celebrate with a weekend in Cornwall over the summer. Send her congrats when it's announced.

Long chat with Fatima after the meeting. Her client in Dubai keeps changing the brief, deadline is still June 30. She's barely sleeping. Her husband Ahmed is away on business most of next month too. I said I'd cover her Thursday calls, which I'm doing. Check in with her end of the week.
Leon's sister Astrid is getting married in Ghent on 8/16. He's best man and nervous about the speech.
Jen got the flat! Moving in early April, two-bed in Headingley. Her brother Sam is helping with the van.
Isaac's interview at Hughes & Co was yesterday. Forgot to ask how it went. Text him tonight.
Amir's dad is in hospital again, heart thing. Amir flying to Tehran sometime this week. Covering his clients while he's away.
Rebecca and Bruno are hosting Thanksgiving this year, November 26. Rebecca asked me to bring wine, Bruno wants me to bring nothing because he's 'got it covered'. Bringing wine.
Dana's birthday party on Saturday is cancelled, her grandad isn't well. She's going up to Glasgow to be with the family instead. Should ring her Sunday to see how he's doing.
Zhang told me Dong's leaving the company end of next month. Not public yet. Dong apparently got a job at a fintech.
Groceries, dry cleaning, dentist at 3. Call the letting agent about the boiler.
Ryan's moving to Lisbon early next year, remote job. His girlfriend Caitlin is staying put for now, they'll do long distance. He seemed sad about it but sure.
Gift idea for Lin: she mentioned a pottery class voucher would make her year. Birthday is 10/30.
Finn passed his driving test this morning, third attempt! Buying a little Fiat off his cousin.

Caught up with Cem and his wife Zainab over dinner. Their twins are starting nursery in September. Zainab's going back to work part time from June 1 and dreading it a bit. Cem's company might move him to the Birmingham office over the summer, which would mean moving house too. Lots going on. Should invite them round once things settle down.
Yaw's gig on Saturday was amazing. Need to send him the videos I took.
Anan said her manager Ayesha is going on maternity leave in early March and she'll be acting head while she's away. Bit daunting. Anan's partner Reza thinks she'll smash it.
Ahmed's son Malik (everyone calls him Mo) has his GCSE results on August 20. He's convinced he's failed maths.
Isaac's daughter turns 5 on the 18th. She's into dinosaurs and anything sparkly. Don't forget to get something before the weekend.
Magda's moving to Kraków for good. Flight on 6/9, one way. Leaving drinks the Friday before. Nobody can believe it.
Talked to Kofi about the restructure. Redundancy consultations start sometime next week and his whole team is in scope. He's pretty anxious. Need to check in with him after his meeting on the 12th.
Viewing a flat in Clapton Thursday at 6. Then another in Hackney Wick Saturday morning.
Krisztina's partner Leon has a big work presentation to the board on March 4th. She says he's been rehearsing in the kitchen every night. Text him good luck that morning.
Astrid's anniversary is Sept 2. Five years with Tobi. They're going to Rome sometime around then. She dropped a hint that she'd love a new camera strap for the trip.
Nasser's new manager starts Monday. Nasser was hoping to get that job himself, so pretty gutted.

Brunch with Fatima, Jen and Caitlin. Fatima's thinking of moving back to Manchester by the end of the year to be near her mum, who's been unwell. Jen's half marathon is on April 26, she's training like mad. Caitlin's just been promoted to account director! Remind me to send Caitlin a bottle of something nice and ask Jen how the race goes.
Rebecca's mum Dr Brennan is giving a talk at the library on 3/18. Rebecca asked if I'd come along.
Dong's into board games, especially the long strategy ones. Dislikes anything with dice.
Amir called back. His dad's out of hospital and doing better. He's flying home Thursday, back in the office early next week. Ask him how his dad's getting on in a couple of weeks.
